# All 24 charts

Each page has the options, a copyable example and notes on keyboard use. For a live demo with the empty and one-point states, see [charts.productscope.uk](https://charts.productscope.uk).

### Over time

See how a measure moves, repeats or clusters across days, weeks and months.

| Chart | Function | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Line](line.md) | `lineChart` | One or a few series over time, with a typical-value line and an optional comparison. |
| [Stacked area](area.md) | `areaChart` | Volume over time, split into themes, or the same data as a share of the total. |
| [Sparkline](sparkline.md) | `spark` | A tiny trend with no axes, for tables, tiles and lists. |
| [Calendar](calendar.md) | `calendar` | One cell per day, laid out in weeks, to show rhythm and one-off spikes. |
| [Heatmap](heatmap.md) | `heatmap` | A grid of rows against columns, shaded by value, with clear no-data cells. |
| [Small multiples](small-multiples.md) | markup + `spark` | One mini chart per category on a shared layout, with a detail chart for the one you pick. |

### Comparing

Set one thing against another, in order or step by step.

| Chart | Function | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Grouped bars](bars.md) | `barChart` | Compare two measures side by side per period, with a derived line on top. |
| [Ranked bars](hbars.md) | `hbars` | A top-N list with a bar per row, a detail line and optional click-through. |
| [Waterfall](waterfall.md) | `waterfall` | How a starting number becomes an ending number, step by step. |
| [Diverging bars](diverging-bars.md) | `divergingBars` | What went up and what went down: bars either side of a zero line, biggest rise at the top. |
| [Slope chart](slope.md) | `slope` | Two moments side by side, one line per item, so rises and falls read at a glance. |
| [Bump chart](bump.md) | `bump` | Rank over time: who is first this week, and how each one got there. |

### Spread and relationships

See how values are distributed and whether two measures move together.

| Chart | Function | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Histogram](histogram.md) | `histogram` | How a measure is spread: thread length, thread time or cost per response, in bars. |
| [Box plot](box-plot.md) | `boxPlot` | Compare the spread of a measure across groups: median, quartiles, whiskers and outliers. |
| [Scatter and bubble](scatter.md) | `scatter` | Two measures against each other, one dot per item, with size, groups and a trend line. |

### Parts of a whole

Show what a total is made of and where it goes.

| Chart | Function | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Stacked](stacked.md) | `barChart` | Parts of a whole per period, one stable colour per category. |
| [Donut](donut.md) | `donut` | Share of a total, with the hovered slice read out in the centre. |
| [Treemap](treemap.md) | `treemap` | Area proportional to value, packed into a rectangle. |
| [Flow](flow.md) | `flow` | Where money comes from and where it goes, as proportional ribbons. |
| [Funnel](funnel.md) | `funnel` | A journey where each step can only lose people, with the drop-off between steps. |

### At a glance

Single figures, targets, the words people use and the exact numbers behind them.

| Chart | Function | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Gauge](gauge.md) | `gauge` | Progress against a budget or limit, with the state spelled out in words. |
| [KPI tiles](kpi-tiles.md) | markup + `spark` | Headline numbers with a change and a sparkline, plus a loading skeleton. |
| [Word cloud](word-cloud.md) | `wordCloud` | The words people use most, sized by how often they appear, with optional colour for rising and falling. |
| [Data table](data-table.md) | `dataTable` | The accessible twin of every chart: plain numbers in a real table. |
